note: wan CNJ when/if — breve-diacritic variant of "wenne", "die breite wenn̆ dir wil" = the width when you will, all CNJ temporal/conditional (breve-diacritic wenne)

werden VEX will/become — Bavarian dialectal 2sg present "du wirft" = Standard "du wirst" (you will), "svnder du wirft geheissen wenne" = but you will be called when, all VEX 2sg indicative

vuoʒ NOM foot — "cz" for "z" + "u" for MHG "uo", genitive form, "des rechten fuzes vnd geuss" = of the right foot and pour, "des rechten fuzes" = of the right foot, all NOM genitive (Leviticus/Exodus consecration ritual)
mittentac NOM midday/south — genitive form, "an der mittagis seiten die" = on the south/midday side the, all NOM genitive (tabernacle orientation context)
reiʒen VRB provoke/entice — ge- prefix + "cz" for "z", past participle, "das do gereiczet wart wider" = that was provoked there against, all VRB past part. (ge+reizen)

vorstat NOM suburb/outlying area — dative/nom. form, "vnd ire vorstete in dem" = and their suburbs in the, all NOM (variant of vorsteten)
gehoerde NOM hearing/auditory faculty — "ehe" for "oerd" variant, "vnd das gehere weislecht vnd" = and the hearing/auditory wisdom and, all NOM (biblical sensory context)
zunge NOM tongue/language — "cz" for "z" Bavarian variant, "In deutsche czunge v­ vnd" = In German tongue/language, all NOM

leie NOM kind/sort/manner — short form meaning "Art, Weise" (kind/sort, not layman), "Noch der lei das do" = still the kind/type that there, "ouf welcher lei der toten" = of which kind of the dead, all NOM (closest available lemma; semantic field is "kind/sort" not "layman")
pulvis NOM powder/dust — "v" for "v", MHG/Latin pulvis (powder, incense ingredient), "vnd thymiamischen puluer czu machen" = and thyme-incense powder to make, all NOM (incense/tabernacle context)
zweihundert NUM two hundred — "cz" for "z" Bavarian variant, "iar vnd czweihundert iare" = year and two hundred years, all NUM
seim NOM honeycomb/honey-wax — compound form (honig+seim), "vnd von honikseim Hŏre" = and from honeycomb, all NOM (compound of honig + seim; biblical manna/offering context)
niuwekomen VRB newcomer/newly arrived — compound "new+kommen", "gerichte des newkomen vnd des" = judgment of the newcomer and, all VRB/NOM (Leviticus resident alien context)
niuwekomen VRB newcomer/newly arrived — "ev" for "iu" variant of newkomen, "von den nevkomen di do" = from the newcomers who there, all VRB/NOM (same word as newkomen, variant spelling)
klûben VRB to pick/glean — "cl" for "kl" scribal variant, "geen vnd clouben stuppil vnd" = go and glean stubble and, all VRB (gleaning context, Leviticus harvest law)
antvanc NOM beginning/inception — "v" for "f" variant of anevanc, "Aber der anevank seines reiches" = But the beginning of his kingdom, all NOM (Genesis Nimrod passage)
kembel NOM camel — Latin/Romance spelling "camel" vs MHG "kembel", "brachte czehen camel von der" = brought ten camels from the, "czehen camel" = ten camels, all NOM (Genesis Rebekah context)
zige NOM goat — "cz" for "z" Bavarian variant, "das ein czige ist sein" = that a goat is, all NOM (Leviticus clean/unclean animals)
